notes.title: Update Notes for July 24
notes.content:
Issues addressed:
- Fixed bug that could block player input on Gaze of the King fight
- Added more invincibility frames after dash
- "Get rejected by the Smug Toad" achievement will be given to you if you got the key on the first try (will need to visit the toad an extra time)
- Increased reading time on text stones
